topic: 专项特训：关系代词与关系副词 (Relative Pronouns & Adverbs: who, which, that, whose, where, when)

questions.question: The boy ______ won the school spelling bee is my cousin Leo.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人（The boy），在定语从句中作主语，应用关系代词 who。

questions.question: This is the mystery book ______ I borrowed from the local library yesterday.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物（the mystery book），在从句中作宾语，应用关系代词 which 或 that。

questions.question: Do you know the girl ______ dog barked at the mail carrier this morning?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the girl，与 dog 之间存在所属关系（女孩的小狗），表示“……的”，应使用所属关系代词 whose。

questions.question: The science museum is a fantastic place ______ students can learn about solar energy.
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点（a fantastic place），在从句中作地点状语（in the place），应用关系副词 where。

questions.question: Autumn is the season ______ leaves turn bright red and gold.
questions.explanation: 先行词是时间名词（the season），在从句中作时间状语，应用关系副词 when。

questions.question: The astronaut ______ we interviewed during the live broadcast was very inspiring.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人（The astronaut），且在从句 we interviewed... 中作宾语，规范的宾格关系代词为 whom（亦可用 who/that）。

questions.question: Look at the cute puppy ______ tail is wagging so fast!
questions.explanation: puppy 与 tail 为所属关系，表示“小狗的尾巴”，whose 既可指代人也可指代动物的所属关系。

questions.question: The telescope ______ stands on the balcony belongs to my grandfather.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物（The telescope），在从句中作主语，选项中 that 正确指代物。

questions.question: Is this the art studio ______ Mrs. Green teaches pottery classes?
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点（the art studio），从句主谓宾完整，缺地点状语（in the art studio），用 where。

questions.question: I visited an old castle ______ was built more than five hundred years ago.
questions.explanation: 先行词虽然是地点（an old castle），但在定语从句中作主语（was built...），不能用关系副词 where，必须用代词 which 或 that。

questions.question: I still remember the stormy night ______ the power suddenly went out.
questions.explanation: 先行词是时间名词（the stormy night），在从句中作时间状语，因此用 when。

questions.question: The pilot ______ flew us safely across the Atlantic Ocean was very experienced.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人（The pilot），从句缺主语，用 who。

questions.question: Can you show me the drawer ______ you keep the colored pencils?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the drawer（抽屉），在从句中作地点状语（keep the pencils in the drawer），故选 where。

questions.question: The student ______ backpack was left in the cafeteria can collect it at the office.
questions.explanation: backpack 与 student 存在所有权关系，表示“书包落在食堂的学生”，应选用 whose。

questions.question: Everything ______ our teacher explained today was easy to understand.
questions.explanation: 当先行词是不定代词（如 everything, anything, nothing）时，关系代词习惯上只用 that 而不用 which。

questions.question: The computer game ______ Dad bought for my birthday has exciting graphics.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物（The computer game），在从句中作 bought 的宾语，用 which 或 that。

questions.question: We went to the wildlife park ______ we saw rare pandas eating bamboo.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the wildlife park，从句中缺少地点状语（in the wildlife park），应用 where。

questions.question: The doctor ______ took care of my injured ankle was very gentle.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人（The doctor），在从句中作主语，故用 who。

questions.question: This is the most exciting documentary ______ I have ever watched.
questions.explanation: 当先行词被形容词最高级（the most exciting）修饰时，关系代词优先选用 that。

questions.question: A baker is a person ______ makes delicious bread and pastries.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 a person（人），在定语从句中作主语，用 who。

questions.question: The treehouse ______ my brother built in the backyard is very sturdy.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物（The treehouse），从句中 built 缺宾语，可以用 that 或 which。

questions.question: Do you remember the exact day ______ we started our robotics project?
questions.explanation: 先行词是 the exact day（具体日子），在从句中充当时间状语（on that day），应用 when。

questions.question: The mountain climber ______ fingers were frozen refused to give up.
questions.explanation: fingers 属于 the mountain climber，先行词与名词构成定语关系，用 whose。

questions.question: This is the swimming pool ______ our school swim team practices every Friday.
questions.explanation: 先行词是地点 the swimming pool，从句 practices 在此作不及物用法，缺地点状语（in the pool），用 where。

questions.question: The hotel ______ we stayed during our trip to London was near the river.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The hotel，在定语从句 we stayed 中表示停留的地点（stayed at/in the hotel），作状语，用 where。

questions.question: He gave me all the stamps ______ he had collected over the past three years.
questions.explanation: 当先行词被 all 修饰时，定语从句的关系代词通常用 that，不用 which 或 what。

questions.question: The scientist ______ invented this recycling machine won a prestigious prize.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The scientist，在从句中作主语，应用 who。

questions.question: A dictionary is a useful reference book ______ explains the meanings of words.
questions.explanation: 先行词是物（a useful reference book），在从句中作主语，用 which 或 that。

questions.question: The girl ______ mother is a famous pianist played a Chopin nocturne beautifully.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 The girl，从句主语 mother 与其是母女所属关系（the girl's mother），故选 whose。

questions.question: There was a moment in the chess match ______ everyone in the room went completely silent.
questions.explanation: 先行词是 a moment（一个时刻），表示时间，从句中缺少时间状语（at that moment），故用关系副词 when。
